definitions.explanation: The foremost line of a battle or conflict. Also used figuratively for the forefront of any activity or field.
A boundary between two air masses of different temperatures, as used in meteorology. Commonly heard in weather forecasts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前線|ぜんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}られた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: The soldiers were sent to the front line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最前線|さいぜんせん}→最前線：13057_saizensen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: He is active at the forefront of research.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前線|ぜんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}→感謝：00181_kansha⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to thank the people working on the front lines of healthcare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧{前線|ぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
examples.english: The rainy season front is approaching.

examples.japanese: {前線|ぜんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.english: A stationary front lingered over the Japanese archipelago, causing heavy rain across the country.

notes:
{前線|ぜんせん} has two main meanings: (1) the front line of battle or activity, and (2) a weather front in meteorology.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (front) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line).

SENSE 1 — FRONT LINE:
Used literally for military contexts and figuratively for being at the forefront of any field.
- ⟦{最前線|さいぜんせん}→最前線：13057_saizensen⟧: the very forefront
- {前線|ぜんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the front line
- ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前線|ぜんせん}: the front lines of healthcare

SENSE 2 — WEATHER FRONT:
A standard meteorology term heard daily in weather forecasts.
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧{前線|ぜんせん}: rainy season front
- ⟦{停滞|ていたい}→停滞：07427_teitai⟧{前線|ぜんせん}: stationary front
- {寒冷|かんれい}{前線|ぜんせん}: cold front
- {温暖|おんだん}{前線|ぜんせん}: warm front

USAGE:
The compound ⟦{最前線|さいぜんせん}→最前線：13057_saizensen⟧ (very forefront) is extremely common in both literal and figurative use: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最前線|さいぜんせん}→最前線：13057_saizensen⟧ (the cutting edge of research).
